q: Consider an ideal fluid there must be laminar flow and no ____.
e: Ideal fluids တွင် internal friction မရှိပါ။

q: The mass flowing in section 1 must equal the ____ flowing in section 2.
e: Conservation of mass သည် fluid flow တွင် အကျုံးဝင်သည်။

q: The equation (3.1) states that the liquid entering one end of the pipe leaves from the other end with a constant ____ flow rate.
e: Pipe တစ်ခုတွင် volume flow rate တည်ငြိမ်နေသည်။

q: The larger the area of the pipe, the ____ is the speed; and the smaller the area, the faster is the speed.
e: Fluid ၏ အရှိန်သည် cross-sectional area နှင့် inversely proportional ဖြစ်သည်။

q: For example, the speed of water spraying from a hose increases by making the hose area ____.
e: Area လျှော့ပါက fluid velocity တိုးသည်။
